description: Cave system at the southern edge of the Mendip hills. Finds show activity in the caves from the Iron Age - late Roman periods, this included an inhumation cemetery in the 4th chamber. The RSRB argues that burials and volume of finds should suggest a ritual usage, and marks the site as a 'shrine'.
